About Us

Incorporated in 1989, Rashi Peripherals Limited is among leading national distribution partners for global technology brands in India for information and communications technology (“ICT”) products in terms of revenues and distribution network in Fiscal 2023. (Source: Technopak Report) With a pan India distribution network of 50 branches, 50 service centers and 63 warehouses, we cater to technology requirements of 8407 customers in 680 locations across India.

We primarily operate the two following verticals:

  • Personal Computing, Enterprise and Cloud Solutions (PES)
  • Lifestyle and IT essentials (LIT)

We are the distribution partner of 52 global technology brands in India. Along with conventional distribution, we offer value added support such as pre-sale activities, solutions design, technical support, credit support and warranty management services.

We consider our key value propositions to our customers to be our relationships with our Channel Partners, diverse portfolio, extensive pan-India operations and commitment to quality of service, which have reflected in our increasing customer stickiness over the years. Our contribution has been acknowledged and awarded by the vendors and media publications. In Fiscal 2023, we received 483 media mentions.


Vision: To have a multi-channel, pan-India distribution footprint and adopt a committed high-engagement strategy with our General Trade, Modern Trade and E-Commerce channels.

 

Core Values: Ethical business practices and highest business efficiency.
